title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali on Ghadir
intro: The longer Ghadir ziyarat of Imam Ali for 18 Dhu al-Hijjah, distinct from the source’s short Ghadir variant.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Ali on Ghadir with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: Though authoritative chains of authority, It is narrated that Imam `Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi (peace be upon him) said the following form of ziyarah at the holy tomb of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) on the Ghadir day when he was summoned by the `Abbasid ruler, al-Mu`tasim, to be present before him in Iraq. (It contains a full overview of events in his life.)

blocks.english: Peace be upon Muhammad the Messenger of Allah,
the seal of the Prophets,
the chief of the Messengers,
and the choice of the Lord of the worlds,
whom Allah has entrusted with His Revelations
and with His determined commandments,
who sealed the previous Messages,
paved the way to the coming blessings,
and Who prevails over all that.
May the mercy, blessings, peace,
benedictions, and greetings of Allah be upon him, too.
Peace be upon the Prophets and Messengers of Allah,
and upon His favorite angels
and righteous saints.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful,
the chief of the Prophets’ successors,
the heir of the Prophets’ knowledge,
the friend of the Lord of the worlds,
and my master as well as the master of all of the believers.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you, too.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya mawlaya ya amira almu'minina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O my master, O Commander of the Faithful,
the trustee of Allah on His lands,
the envoy of Him amongst His creatures,
and His conclusive argument against His servants.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا دِينَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْقَوِيمَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O true religion of Allah
and the straight path of Him.
Peace be upon you, O the Great News
about whom they differ
and they shall be asked.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful.
You believed in Allah while they were polytheists,

blocks.transliteration: wa saddaqta bilhaqqi wa hum mukadhdhibuna
blocks.english: accepted the truth while they belied it,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi wa hum muhjimuna
blocks.english: strove for the sake of Allah while they refrained,
and worshipped Allah with full sincerity to Him in obedience
while you were steadfast, depending upon Him totally, until death came upon you.
Verily, curse of Allah be upon the wrongdoers.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Muslims,
head of the believers,
guide of the pious ones,
and leader of the white-forehead ones.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
I bear witness that you are indeed the brother of Allah’s Messenger,
the successor of him, the heir of his knowledge,
his trustee on his laws,
his representative in his nation,
and the first to believe in Allah
and to accept as true all that which was revealed to Allah’s Prophet.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَلَّغَ عَنِ ٱللَّهِ مَا أَنْزَلَهُ فِيكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annahu qad ballagha `an allahi ma anzalahu fika
blocks.english: I also bear witness that he (i.e. the Prophet) conveyed all that which Allah revealed to him concerning you;
so, he expounded openly what he was commanded (to expound),

blocks.arabic: وَأَوْجَبَ عَلَىٰ أُمَّتِهِ فَرْضَ طَاعَتِكَ وَوِلاَيَتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa awjaba `ala ummatihi farda ta`atika wa wilayatika
blocks.english: declared to his nation the duty of obedience and loyalty to you,
ordered them to swear allegiance to you,

blocks.transliteration: wa ja`alaka awla bilmu'minina min anfusihim
blocks.english: and declared you as enjoying more priority on the believers than that which they enjoy on themselves
in the same was as Allah has made him enjoy the same.
He then asked Allah the All-exalted to be the witness on them (in this respect),
saying, “Have I conveyed?”
They answered, “Yes, you have. We swear to it by Allah.”
He thus said, “O Allah, be the witness

blocks.arabic: وَكَفَىٰ بِكَ شَهِيداً وَحَاكِماً بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ.“
blocks.transliteration: wa kafa bika shahidan wa hakiman bayna al`ibadi
blocks.english: and You are sufficient Witness and Judge between the servants (0f Yours).”

blocks.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ جَاحِدَ وِلاَيَتِكَ بَعْدَ ٱلإِقْرَارِ
blocks.transliteration: fala`ana allahu jahida wilayatika ba`da al-iqrari
blocks.english: Hence, curse of Allah be upon him who denied the allegiance to you after he had confessed of it
and upon him who breached his pledge to you after he had taken it.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ وَفَيْتَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wafayta bi`ahdi allahi ta`ala
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you have indeed observed your pledge to Almighty Allah

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَعَالَىٰ مُوفٍ لَكَ بِعَهْدِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa anna allaha ta`ala mufin laka bi`ahdihi
blocks.english: and that Almighty Allah, in return, shall observe His pledge to you.

blocks.arabic: ”وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْراً عَظِيماً.“
blocks.transliteration: wa man awfa bima `ahada `alayhu allaha fasayu'tihi ajran `aziman
blocks.english: “Therefore, whoever fulfills what he has covenanted with Allah, He will grant him a mighty reward.”

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka amiru almu'minina alhaqqu
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you are truly the commander of the faithful,
the Divine Revelation did declare your commissioned leadership,

blocks.arabic: وَأَخَذَ لَكَ ٱلْعَهْدَ عَلَىٰ ٱلأُمَّةِ بِذٰلِكَ ٱلرَّسُولُ
blocks.transliteration: wa akhadha laka al`ahda `ala al'ummati bidhalika alrrasulu
blocks.english: and the Messenger made a covenant with the people (that they would be under your leadership).

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wa `ammaka wa akhaka
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you, along with your uncle and brother,
traded with Allah in your souls;
He therefore revealed about you this:

blocks.arabic: «إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: inna allaha ishtara min almu'minina anfusahum wa amwalahum
blocks.english: “Surely, Allah has bought of the believers their persons and their property for this,
that they shall have Paradise;

blocks.arabic: يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ
blocks.transliteration: yuqatiluna fi sabili allahi fayaqtuluna wa yuqtaluna
blocks.english: they fight in Allah's way, so they slay and are slain;

blocks.arabic: وَعْداً عَلَيْهِ حَقّاً فِي ٱلتَّوْرَاةِ وَٱلإِنْجِيلِ وَٱلْقُرْآنِ
blocks.transliteration: wa`dan `alayhi haqqan fi alttawrati wal-injili walqur'ani
blocks.english: a promise which is binding on Him in the Torah and the Bible and the Qur'an;

blocks.transliteration: wa man awfa bi`ahdihi min allahi
blocks.english: and who is more faithful to his covenant than Allah?
Rejoice therefore in the pledge which you have made;
and that is the mighty achievement.
They who turn to Allah, who serve Him,
who praise Him, who fast,
who bow down, who prostrate themselves,
who enjoin what is good and forbid what is evil,

blocks.transliteration: walhafizuna lihududi allahi wa bashshir almu'minina
blocks.english: and who keep the limits of Allah; and give good news to the believers.”
O Commander of the Faithful, I bear witness

blocks.arabic: أَنَّ ٱلشَّاكَّ فِيكَ مَا آمَنَ بِٱلرَّسُولِ ٱلأَمِينِ
blocks.transliteration: anna alshshakka fika ma amana bilrrasuli al-amini
blocks.english: that whoever doubts about you has never believed in the Trusted Messenger,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْعَادِلَ بِكَ غَيْرَكَ عَانِدٌ عَنِ ٱلدِّينِ ٱلْقَوِيمِ
blocks.transliteration: wa anna al`adila bika ghayraka `anidun `an alddini alqawimi
blocks.english: and whoever leaves you to choose another (as his leader) has indeed diverted the true religion,
that the Lord of the worlds has chosen for us,
and that He completed it on the Ghadir Day through (declaring) the Divinely commissioned leadership of you.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ ٱلْمَعْنِيُّ بِقَوْلِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ:
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka alma`niyyu biqawli al`azizi alrrahimi
blocks.english: And I bear witness that you are the one intended in the following saying of the Almighty, All-merciful Lord:

blocks.transliteration: wa anna hadha sirati mustaqiman fattabi`uhu
blocks.english: “And this is My path, the right one; therefore, follow it,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ تَتَّبِعُوا ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ.“
blocks.transliteration: wa la tattabi`u alssubula fatafarraqa bikum `an sabilihi
blocks.english: and follow not other ways, for they will lead you away from His way.”

blocks.arabic: ضَلَّ وَٱللَّهِ وَأَضَلَّ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ سِوَاكَ
blocks.transliteration: dalla wallahi wa adalla man ittaba`a siwaka
blocks.english: I swear by Allah that whoever follows any one other than you has in fact strayed off the right way and misled others (i.e. those who imitate him),
and that whoever incurs the hostility of you has undoubtedly rejected the right.
O Allah, we have listened to Your command
obeyed, and followed Your straight path;
therefore, (please do) guide us, O our Lord!

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا إِلَىٰ طَاعَتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa la tuzigh qulubana ba`da idh hadaytana ila ta`atika
blocks.english: And do not cause our hearts to deviate after You have guided us to the obedience to You,
and include us with those who always thank You for Your bounties.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَزَلْ لِلْهَوَىٰ مُخَالِفاً
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka lam tazal lilhawa mukhalifan
blocks.english: And I also bear witness that you have always been at variance with whimsical desires
as you have always been in line with piety,
you have always been capable of suppressing your rage,
you have always forgiven and pardoned people,
and when Allah is disobeyed, you have always been furious,
and when He is obeyed, you have always been pleased,
and you have always carried out what Allah has commissioned you to do,
you have always observed what has been entrusted with you,
you have always kept what has been confided to you,
you have always conveyed what you were ordered to convey,
and you have always expected that which you were promised.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka ma ittaqayta dari`an
blocks.english: And I bear witness that as you sometimes conceded some things, you did not do that on account of humiliation,
and as you sometimes did not demand with your right, you did not do that on account of fear,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ أَحْجَمْتَ عَنْ مُجَاهَدَةِ غَاصِبِيكَ نَاكِلاً
blocks.transliteration: wa la ahjamta `an mujahadati ghasibika nakilan
blocks.english: and as you sometimes stopped combating those who usurped your right, you did not do so on account of weakness,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ أَظْهَرْتَ ٱلرِّضَا بِخِلاَفِ مَا يُرْضِي ٱللَّهَ مُدَاهِناً
blocks.transliteration: wa la azharta alrrida bikhilafi ma yurdi allaha mudahinan
blocks.english: and as you (on a certain occasion) showed contentment to things to which Allah is not pleased, you did not do so on account of flattery,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ وَهَنْتَ لِمَا أَصَابَكَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la wahanta lima asabaka fi sabili allahi
blocks.english: and you have never been weakened by what befell you for the sake of Allah,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ ضَعُفْتَ وَلاَ ٱسْتَكَنْتَ عَنْ طَلَبِ حَقِّكَ مُرَاقِباً
blocks.transliteration: wa la da`ufta wa la istakanta `an talabi haqqika muraqiban
blocks.english: and you have never been feeble and you have never abased yourself as regards demanding with your rights on account of fear.
I seek Allah’s refuge against such claims;
rather, when you were wronged, you relied upon your Lord in these questions
and entrusted your affair to Him,
and as you reminded them (of their allegiance to you), they did not regard it,
and as you preached them, they did not accept from you,
and as you instructed them to fear Allah, they did not mind.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka ya amira almu'minina
blocks.english: I also bear witness, O Commander of the Faithful,
that you strove in the way of Allah in the most appropriate way
until Allah summoned you to be in His vicinity,
chose to grasp you,

blocks.transliteration: wa alzama a`da'aka alhujjata biqatlihim iyyaka
blocks.english: and established the argument against your enemies who killed you,
so that you should have argument against them,

blocks.arabic: مَعَ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحُجَجِ ٱلْبَالِغَةِ عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ
blocks.transliteration: ma`a ma laka min alhujaji albalighati `ala jami`i khalqihi
blocks.english: although you enjoy conclusive arguments against all of His creatures.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful.
You have worshipped Allah sincerely,
striven in the way of Allah steadfastly,
sacrificed yourself, seeking Allah’s judgment,
acted upon His Book,
followed His Prophet’s instructions,
performed the prayers,
paid the zakat,
enjoined what is right,
and forbidden what is wrong as much as you could,
seeking what is possessed by Allah
and desiring for that which Allah has promised.
You have never cared for misfortunes,
never yielded to the hardships,
and never stopped fighting against any warrior on account of fear.

blocks.arabic: أَفِكَ مَنْ نَسَبَ غَيْرَ ذٰلِكَ إِلَيْكَ
blocks.transliteration: afika man nasaba ghayra dhalika ilayka
blocks.english: Indeed, whoever claims anything opposite to this to you is actually fabricating
and is forging lies to you,
and whoever leaves your path is drawing himself near to destruction.

blocks.arabic: لَقَدْ جَاهَدْتَ فِي ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ ٱلْجِهَادِ
blocks.transliteration: laqad jahadta fi allahi haqqa aljihadi
blocks.english: You have certainly striven in the way of Allah as exactly as required,
stood harm for the sake of Allah,

blocks.transliteration: wa anta awwalu man amana billahi
blocks.english: have been the foremost to believe in Allah,
the first to offer prayer and to strive,

blocks.transliteration: wa abda safhatahu fi dari alshshirki
blocks.english: and the first to expose himself in the land of the polytheists,
while the lands were suffocated with deviation,
Satan was worshipped openly,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلْقَائِلُ: ”لاَ تَزِيدُنِي كَثْرَةُ ٱلنَّاسِ حَوْلِي عِزَّةً
blocks.transliteration: wa anta alqa'ilu la taziduni kathratu alnnasi hawli `izzatan
blocks.english: and (in the midst of this) you said, “The big number of people that surround me shall never increase my might,
nor shall their departing me make me feel lonely.

blocks.arabic: وَلَوْ أَسْلَمَنِيَ ٱلنَّاسُ جَمِيعاً لَمْ أَكُنْ مُتَضَرِّعاً.“
blocks.transliteration: wa law aslamani alnnasu jami`an lam akun mutadarri`an
blocks.english: I thus shall never submit even if all peoples desert me.”
Because you resorted to Allah, you were the mightiest,
and because you preferred the Next World to this worldly life, you have been ascetic.
Thus, Allah supported, guided,
chose, and selected you.
Your deeds were never contradictory,
your words were never paradoxical,
your situations were never fickle,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ ٱدَّعَيْتَ وَلاَ ٱفْتَرَيْتَ عَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ كَذِباً
blocks.transliteration: wa la idda`ayta wa la iftarayta `ala allahi kadhiban
blocks.english: you have never claimed falsely or forged lies against Allah,
you have never been greedy for the wreckage of this world,
you have never been defiled by sins,

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ تَزَلْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam tazal `ala bayyinatin min rabbika
blocks.english: you have always had manifest proof from your Lord,
and you have always been certain of what you do,

blocks.arabic: تَهْدِي إِلَىٰ ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
blocks.transliteration: tahdi ila alhaqqi wa ila siratin mustaqimin
blocks.english: as you used to guide to the right and to a straight path.
I bear true witness
and I truly swear by Allah

blocks.arabic: أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً وَآلَهُ صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ سَادَاتُ ٱلْخَلْقِ
blocks.transliteration: anna muhammadan wa alahu salawatu allahi `alayhim sadatu alkhalqi
blocks.english: that Muhammad and his Household—may Allah’s blessings be upon them—are the masters of all creatures

blocks.transliteration: wa annaka mawlaya wa mawla almu'minina
blocks.english: and you are indeed my master and the master of all believers,
the servant and friend of Allah,

blocks.transliteration: wa akhu alrrasuli wa wasiyyuhu wa warithuhu
blocks.english: the brother, successor, and heir of the Messenger,
who used to say to you,

blocks.arabic: ”وَٱلَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِٱلْحَقِّ مَا آمَنَ بِي مَنْ كَفَرَ بِكَ
blocks.transliteration: walladhi ba`athani bilhaqqi ma amana bi man kafara bika
blocks.english: “I swear this by Him Who sent me with the truth: whoever denies you has never believed in me,

blocks.transliteration: wa la aqarra billahi man jahadaka
blocks.english: whoever rejects you has never confessed of Allah’s existence,
whoever abandons you has actually strayed off,

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ يَهْتَدِ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَلاَ إِلَيَّ مَنْ لاَ يَهْتَدِي بِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam yahtadi ila allahi wa la ilayya man la yahtadi bika
blocks.english: and whoever is not guided be you has never found the way to Allah or to me.

blocks.transliteration: wa huwa qawlu rabbi `azza wa jalla
blocks.english: Confirming this, my Lord the the Almighty and All-majestic says,

blocks.arabic: «وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٌ لِمَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحاً
blocks.transliteration: wa inni laghaffarun liman taba wa amana wa `amila salihan
blocks.english: ‘Most surely, I am most Forgiving to him who repents and believes and does good,
then follows the right path.’ To follow the right path is to adhere to your Divinely commissioned leadership.”
O master, your favor cannot be concealed
and your light cannot be extinguished.

blocks.transliteration: wa anna man jahadaka alzzalumu al-ashqa
blocks.english: Verily, he who rejects you shall be the most misfortunate wrongdoer.
O master, you are the (Divine) claim against the servants,
the guiding to uprightness,
and our means on the Promised Day.

blocks.arabic: مَوْلاَيَ لَقَدْ رَفَعَ ٱللَّهُ فِي ٱلأُولَىٰ مَنْزِلَتَكَ
blocks.transliteration: mawlaya laqad rafa`a allahu fi al'ula manzilataka
blocks.english: O master, Allah has indeed elevated your standing in this world,
raised your rank in the Hereafter,

blocks.arabic: وَبَصَّرَكَ مَا عَمِيَ عَلَىٰ مَنْ خَالَفَكَ
blocks.english: and led you to that which has not been seen by those who antagonized you,

blocks.arabic: وَحَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَوَاهِبِ ٱللَّهِ لَكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa hala baynaka wa bayna mawahibi allahi laka
blocks.english: those who stood between you and Allah’s gifts to you.
So, curse of Allah be upon those who violated your sanctity
and those who prevented you from taking your right.
I do bear witness that these are the biggest losers
whose faces shall be scorched by Hellfire
and they therein shall be in severe affliction.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ مَا أَقْدَمْتَ وَلاَ أَحْجَمْتَ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka ma aqdamta wa la ahjamta
blocks.english: And I bear witness that whenever you did something or you avoided doing something,

blocks.transliteration: wa la nataqta wa la amsakta
blocks.english: and whenever you said something or you kept silent;

blocks.transliteration: illa bi-amrin min allahi wa rasulihi
blocks.english: all these were by the order of Allah and His Messenger.
You thus said, “I swear this by Him Who grasps my soul:

blocks.arabic: لَقَدْ نَظَرَ إِلَيَّ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: laqad nazara ilayya rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: when the Messenger of Allah—peace of Allah be upon him and his Household—
watched me striking (the enemies) with my sword ceaselessly, he said to me,

blocks.arabic: ’يَا عَلِيُّ أَنْتَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: ya `aliyyu anta minni bimanzilati haruna min musa
blocks.english: ‘O `Ali, your position to me is the same as (Prophet) Aaron’s position to (Prophet) Moses;
yet, there shall be no prophet after me.

blocks.arabic: وَأُعْلِمُكَ أَنَّ مَوْتَكَ وَحَيَاتَكَ مَعِي وَعَلَىٰ سُنَّتِي.‘
blocks.transliteration: wa u`limuka anna mawtaka wa hayataka ma`i wa `ala sunnati
blocks.english: I would like to further inform you that your death and your lifestyle shall be with me and according to my instruction.’

blocks.transliteration: fawallahi ma kadhibtu wa la kudhdhibtu
blocks.english: (Imam `Ali continued,) I swear by Allah that I have not told untruth and none shall belie me,

blocks.transliteration: wa la dalaltu wa la dulla bi
blocks.english: and I have never strayed off and none shall ever mislead me,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ نَسِيتُ مَا عَهِدَ إِلَيَّ رَبِّي
blocks.transliteration: wa la nasitu ma `ahida ilayya rabbi
blocks.english: and I have never forgotten my Lord’s instructions to me,

blocks.arabic: وَإِنِّي لَعَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي بَيَّنَهَا لِنَبِيِّهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa inni la`ala bayyinatin min rabbi bayyanaha linabiyyihi
blocks.english: and I do follow the true path of my Lord that He showed His Prophet
and the Prophet showed me,

blocks.arabic: وَإِنِّي لَعَلَىٰ ٱلطَّرِيقِ ٱلْوَاضِحِ أَلْفِظُهُ لَفْظاً.“
blocks.transliteration: wa inni la`ala alttariqi alwadihi alfizuhu lafzan
blocks.english: and, most certainly, I am following the lucid path step by step.”
By Allah I swear, true are your words and you have said nothing but the truth.

blocks.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ سَاوَاكَ بِمَنْ نَاوَاكَ
blocks.transliteration: fala`ana allahu man sawaka biman nawaka
blocks.english: Curse of Allah be upon those who compare you to your enemies,
while Allah, Whose Name be elevated, says,

blocks.arabic: ”هَلْ يَسْتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يَعْلَمُون؟“
blocks.transliteration: hal yastawi alladhina ya`lamuna walladhina la ya`lamun
blocks.english: “Are those who know and those who do not know alike?”

blocks.arabic: فَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ عَدَلَ بِكَ مَنْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وِلايَتَكَ
blocks.transliteration: fala`ana allahu man `adala bika man farada allahu `alayhi wilayataka
blocks.english: So, the curse of Allah be upon those who compared you to those whom Allah has ordered to follow your leadership,
while you are the friend of Allah,
the brother of His Messenger,
the defender of His religion,
and the one whose preference (to all others) has been declared by the Qur'an;
hence, Almighty Allah says,

blocks.arabic: ”وَفَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُجَاهِدِينَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْقَاعِدِينَ أَجْراً عَظِيماً.
blocks.transliteration: wa faddala allahu almujahidina `ala alqa`idina ajran `aziman
blocks.english: “And Allah shall grant to the strivers above the holders back a mighty reward.

blocks.transliteration: darajatin minhu wa maghfiratan wa rahmatan
blocks.english: (High) degrees from Him, protection, and mercy.
And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.”
Almighty Allah has also said,

blocks.transliteration: aja`altum siqayata alhajji wa `imarata almasjidi alharami
blocks.english: “Do you make one who undertakes the giving of drink to the pilgrims and the guarding of the Sacred Mosque

blocks.arabic: كَمَنْ آمَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلآخِرِ وَجَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ؟
blocks.transliteration: kaman amana billahi walyawmi al'akhiri wa jahada fi sabili allahi
blocks.english: to be like him who believes in Allah and the latter day and strives hard in Allah's way?
They are not equal with Allah;
and Allah does not guide the unjust people.
Those who believed, fled their homes,

blocks.arabic: وَجَاهَدُوٱ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa jahadu fi sabili allahi bi'amwalihim wa anfusihim
blocks.english: and strove hard in Allah’s way with their property and their souls
are much higher in rank with Allah;
and those are they who are the achievers of their objects.

blocks.transliteration: yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmatin minhu wa ridwanin
blocks.english: Their Lord gives them good news of mercy from Himself and His good pleasure

blocks.transliteration: wa jannatin lahum fiha na`imun muqimun
blocks.english: and gardens, wherein lasting blessings shall be theirs;
abiding therein for ever.
Surely, Allah has a mighty reward with Him.”
I bear witness that Allah’s words of praise mean you exclusively
and you are the most sincere in the obedience to Allah
as you have never accepted any alternative for the right guidance

blocks.transliteration: wa lam tushrik bi`ibadati rabbika ahadan
blocks.english: and you have never associated anyone in your worshipping your Lord.

blocks.transliteration: wa anna allaha ta`ala istajaba linabiyyihi
blocks.english: And Almighty Allah has responded the prayer of His Prophet—

blocks.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِيكَ دَعْوَتَهُ
blocks.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi fika da`watahu
blocks.english: peace of Allah be upon him and his Household—concerning you.

blocks.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ بِإِظْهَارِ مَا أَوْلاَكَ لأُمَّتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: thumma amarahu bi'izhari ma awlaka li'ummatihi
blocks.english: He then ordered him to proclaim the position of succeeding him in (the leadership of) his nation,
as a sign of showing your elevated position,
declaration of the evidence on your leadership,
refutation of the false claims,
and repudiation of all excuses.
But when he (i.e. the Prophet) worried about the sedition that would be aroused by the transgressing group due to such declaration
and he did not want you to be faced by the hypocrites,
the Lord of the worlds revealed to him, saying,

blocks.arabic: ”يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ
blocks.transliteration: ya ayyuha alrrasulu balligh ma unzila ilayka min rabbika
blocks.english: “O Messenger! Proclaim the message which has been sent to you from your Lord.

blocks.arabic: وَإِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa in lam taf`al fama ballaghta risalatahu
blocks.english: If you did it not, you would not have fulfilled and proclaimed His mission.
And Allah will defend you from men (who mean mischief).”
Accordingly, he (i.e. the Prophet) burdened himself with the loads of (long) walking
and stood up under the burning sun in the midst of the desert,
where he delivered a speech, made everyone listen to him,
and called upon them with rhetorical language.
He then asked them all,
“Have I conveyed (the message)?”
“Yes, you have. We swear it by Allah,” they answered.
“O Allah, be the witness!” the Prophet said.

blocks.arabic: ثُمَّ قَالَ: ” أَلَسْتُ أَوْلَىٰ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ؟“
blocks.transliteration: thumma qala alastu awla bilmu'minina min anfusihim
blocks.english: He then added, “Do I not enjoy more priority to the selves of the believers than that which they enjoy on themselves?”
“Yes, you do,” answered they.
Hen then took you from the hand and said,
“This `Ali is now the master of every one who has betaken me as his master.
O Allah, (please do) support those who support `Ali,
be the enemy of those who incur the hostility of `Ali,
give victory to those who stand by `Ali,
and disappoint those who disappoint `Ali.”

blocks.arabic: فَمَا آمَنَ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فِيكَ عَلَىٰ نَبِيِّهِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلٌ
blocks.transliteration: fama amana bima anzala allahu fika `ala nabiyyihi illa qalilun
blocks.english: Nevertheless, none believed in what Allah has revealed to His Prophet about you except a few.

blocks.transliteration: wa la zada aktharahum ghayra takhyyirin
blocks.english: Similarly, this (Divinely commissioned) declaration did not increase others but obstinacy.

blocks.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنْزَلَ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ فِيكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَهُمْ كَارِهُونَ:
blocks.transliteration: wa laqad anzala allahu ta`ala fika min qablu wa hum karihuna
blocks.english: In defiance of them, Almighty Allah had revealed in this connection:
“O you who believe!
Whoever from among you turns back from his religion,

blocks.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِي ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُ
blocks.transliteration: fasawfa ya'ti allahu biqawmin yuhibbuhum wa yuhibbunahu
blocks.english: then Allah will bring a people. He shall love them and they shall love Him.
(They shall be) lowly before the believers,
mighty against the unbelievers.
They shall strive hard in Allah's way
and shall not fear the censure of any censurer.

blocks.arabic: ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ
blocks.transliteration: dhalika fadlu allahi yu'tihi man yasha'u
blocks.english: This is Allah's favor; He gives it to whom He pleases.
And Allah is Ample-giving, Knowing.

blocks.arabic: إِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٱ
blocks.transliteration: innama waliyyukum allahu wa rasuluhu walladhina amanu
blocks.english: Only Allah is your Guardian and His Messenger and those who believe:
those who keep up prayers

blocks.transliteration: wa yu'tuna alzzakata wa hum raki`una
blocks.english: and give alms while they are in the state of the genuflection of prayer.

blocks.arabic: وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٱ
blocks.transliteration: wa man yatawalla allaha wa rasulahu walladhina amanu
blocks.english: And whoever takes Allah and His messenger and those who believe for a guardian,
then, surely, the party of Allah are they that shall be triumphant.”

blocks.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ
blocks.transliteration: rabbana amanna bima anzalta wattaba`na alrrasula
blocks.english: Our Lord! We believe in what You have revealed and we follow the messenger;
so, write us down with those who bear witness.

blocks.arabic: رَبَّنَا لاَ تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
blocks.transliteration: rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba`da idh hadaytana
blocks.english: Our Lord! Make not our hearts to deviate after You have guided us aright.

blocks.transliteration: wa hab lana min ladunka rahmatan
blocks.english: And grant us from Your mercy.
Surely, You are the most liberal Giver.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هٰذَا هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma inna na`lamu anna hadha huwa alhaqqu min `indika
blocks.english: O Allah, We do realize that this is the truth whose source is You.
So, curse those who object, act arrogantly (towards it),
belie, and deny it.

blocks.arabic: وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٱ أَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَنْقَلِبُونَ
blocks.transliteration: wa saya`lamu alladhina zalamu ayya munqalabin yanqalibuna
blocks.english: And they who act unjustly shall know to what final place of turning they shall turn back.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful,
chief of the Prophets’ successors,
foremost of the worshippers,
and most ascetic.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
So be His peace and compliments.

blocks.arabic: أَنْتَ مُطْعِمُ ٱلطَّعَامِ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِيناً وَيَتِيماً وَأَسِيراً
blocks.transliteration: anta mut`imu altta`ami `ala hubbihi miskinan wa yatiman wa asiran
blocks.english: It is you who served a poor man, an orphan, and a prisoner with food on account of your love for Him,

blocks.arabic: لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لاَ تُرِيدُ مِنْهُمْ جَزَاءً وَلاَ شُكُوراً
blocks.transliteration: liwajhi allahi la turidu minhum jaza'an wa la shukuran
blocks.english: (you did so) for the sake of Allah, while you did not ask for reward or thanks.
Hence, Almighty Allah has revealed the following about you:

blocks.arabic: ”وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ
blocks.transliteration: wa yu'thiruna `ala anfusihim wa law kana bihim khasasatun
blocks.english: “And they prefer them to themselves though poverty may afflict them.

blocks.arabic: وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ.“
blocks.transliteration: wa man yuqa shuhha nafsihi fa'ula'ika hum almuflihuna
blocks.english: And whoever is preserved from the niggardliness of his soul, these it is that are the successful ones.”
Verily, it is you who is the suppressor of rage
and it is you who is the pardoner of people,
and Allah loves the good-doers.

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلصَّابِرُ فِي ٱلْبَأْسَاءِ وَٱلضَّرَّاءِ وَحِينَ ٱلْبَأْسِ
blocks.transliteration: wa anta alssabiru fi alba'sa'i walddarra'i wa hina alba'si
blocks.english: It is also you who is the steadfast in distress and affliction, as well as in times of conflicts.
And it is you who distributes things completely equally,
who is just among the subjects,

blocks.arabic: وَٱلْعَالِمُ بِحُدُودِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
blocks.transliteration: wal`alimu bihududi allahi min jami`i albariyyati
blocks.english: and the one having full acquaintance with the laws of Allah among all people.

blocks.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ أَخْبَرَ عَمَّا أَوْلاَكَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ بِقَوْلِهِ:
blocks.transliteration: wallahu ta`ala akhbara `amma awlaka min fadlihi biqawlihi
blocks.english: Informing about the favors that He has conferred upon you, Allah the All-exalted says,

blocks.transliteration: afaman kana mu'minan kaman kana fasiqan
blocks.english: “Is he then who is a believer like him who is a transgressor?
They are not equal.
As for those who believe and do good,

blocks.arabic: فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلاً بِمَا كَانُوٱ يَعْمَلُونَ.“
blocks.transliteration: falahum jannatu alma'wa nuzulan bima kanu ya`maluna
blocks.english: the gardens of Paradise are their abiding-place; an entertainment for what they did.”
It is you to whom the knowledge of the Divine Revelation is given exclusively
as well as the laws of true interpretation (of the Holy Qur'an)
and the words of the Messenger.
You are known for your unforgettable situations,
renowned positions,
and memorable events,
in the Battle of Badr and the Battle of the Allies (al-Ahzab):

blocks.transliteration: idh zaghat al-absaru wa balaghat alqulubu alhanajira
blocks.english: “When the eyes turned dull, and the hearts rose up to the throats,
and you began to think diverse thoughts of Allah.

blocks.arabic: هُنَالِكَ ٱبْتُلِيَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوٱ زِلْزَالاً شَدِيداً.
blocks.transliteration: hunalika ibtuliya almu'minuna wa zulzilu zilzalan shadidan
blocks.english: There, the believers were tried and they were shaken with severe shaking.

blocks.arabic: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَافِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ:
blocks.transliteration: wa idh yaqulu almunafiquna walladhina fi qulubihim maradun
blocks.english: And when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was a disease began to say:

blocks.arabic: مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلاَّ غُرُوراً.
blocks.transliteration: ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu illa ghururan
blocks.english: ‘Allah and His Messenger did not promise us (victory) but only to deceive.’
And when a party of them said,

blocks.arabic: يَا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لاَ مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوٱ
blocks.transliteration: ya ahla yathriba la muqama lakum farji`u
blocks.english: ‘O people of Yathrib! There is no place to stand for you here; therefore, go back.’
And a party of them asked permission of the prophet,
saying: ‘Surely, our houses are exposed.’

blocks.arabic: وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِنْ يُرِيدُونَ إِلاَّ فِرَاراً.“
blocks.transliteration: wa ma hiya bi`awratin in yuriduna illa firaran
blocks.english: And they were not exposed; they only desired to fly away.”
Almighty Allah has also said:

blocks.transliteration: wa lamma ra'a almu'minuna al-ahzaba qalu
blocks.english: “And when the believers saw the allies, they said:

blocks.transliteration: hadha ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu
blocks.english: ‘This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us.
And Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.’

blocks.transliteration: wa ma zadahum illa imanan wa tasliman
blocks.english: And it only increased them in faith and submission.”
On that day, you (O `Ali) killed their knight, `Amr (ibn `Abd-Wadd)
and defeated their allies:

blocks.transliteration: wa radda allahu alladhina kafaru bighayzihim
blocks.english: “And Allah turned back the unbelievers in their rage.
They did not obtain any advantage.
And Allah sufficed the believers in fighting.
And Allah is Strong, Mighty.”

blocks.arabic: وَيَوْمَ أُحُدٍ: ”إِذْ يُصْعِدُونَ وَلاَ يَلْوُونَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ
blocks.transliteration: wa yawma uhudin idh yus`iduna wa la yalwuna `ala ahadin
blocks.english: On the Battle of Uhud: “When they ran off precipitately and did not wait for any one
and the Messenger was calling them from their rear.”

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْتَ تَذُودُ بِهِمُ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ
blocks.transliteration: wa anta tadhudu bihim almushrikina `an alnnabiyyi
blocks.english: And you were engaged in preventing the polytheists from reaching the Prophet,
on both sides—the right and the left,

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ رَدَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ عَنْكُمَا خَائِفِينَ
blocks.english: until Almighty Allah drove them back, full of fear.
Hence, He gave victory, by means of you, to the disappointing ones.

blocks.arabic: وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ عَلَىٰ مَا نَطَقَ بِهِ ٱلتَّنْزِيلُ:
blocks.transliteration: wa yawma hunaynin `ala ma nataqa bihi alttanzilu
blocks.english: On the Battle of Hunayn, as is accounted by the Divine Revelation:

blocks.arabic: ”إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْكُمْ شَيْئاً
blocks.transliteration: idh a`jabatkum kathratukum falam tughni `ankum shay'an
blocks.english: “When your great numbers made you vain, but they availed you nothing.
And the earth became strait to you notwithstanding its spaciousness,
then you turned back retreating.

blocks.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنْزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ.“
blocks.transliteration: thumma anzala allahu sakinatahu `ala rasulihi wa `ala almu'minina
blocks.english: Then, Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers.”
“The believers” were you and your party.
You uncle, al-`Abbas, was calling at the defeated party:
“O companions of Surah al-Baqarah!
O owners of the Allegiance of the Tree!”

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ ٱسْتَجَابَ لَهُ قَوْمٌ قَدْ كَفَيْتَهُمُ ٱلْمَؤُونَةَ
blocks.transliteration: hatta istajaba lahu qawmun qad kafaytahum alma'unata
blocks.english: He still shouted until a group responded to him, and it was you who replaced them in fighting,
and it was you who aided the Prophet instead of them.
They therefore returned free from reward,
and hoping for repentance, as was promised by Almighty Allah.

blocks.transliteration: wa dhalika qawlu allahi jalla dhikruhu
blocks.english: He, majestic be His mention, says,

blocks.arabic: ”ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ عَلَىٰ مَنْ يَشَاءُ.“
blocks.transliteration: thumma yatubu allahu min ba`di dhalika `ala man yasha'u
blocks.english: “Then will Allah, after this, turn mercifully to whom He pleases.”
As for you, you were awarded the rank of steadfastness
and prized the great reward.

blocks.arabic: وَيَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ إِذْ أَظْهَرَ ٱللَّهُ خَوَرَ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa yawma khaybara idh azhara allahu khawara almunafiqina
blocks.english: On the Battle of Khaybar, when Allah exposed the cowardice of the hypocrites
and cut off the roots of the atheists,
so, all praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds (for that):

blocks.arabic: ”وَلَقَدْ كَانُوٱ عَاهَدُوٱ ٱللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لاَ يُوَلُّونَ ٱلأَدْبَارَ
blocks.transliteration: wa laqad kanu `ahadu allaha min qablu la yuwalluna al-adbara
blocks.english: “And, certainly, they had made a covenant with Allah before, that they would not turn their backs.
And Allah's covenant shall be inquired of.”
O master, you are the conclusive argument (of Allah),
the clear course,
the poured grace,
and the radiant evidence.

blocks.arabic: فَهَنِيئاً لَكَ بِمَا آتَاكَ ٱللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلٍ
blocks.transliteration: fahani'an laka bima ataka allahu min fadlin
blocks.english: So, congratulations, for the favors that Allah has given you.
perdition overtake your enemies, the ignorant!

blocks.arabic: شَهِدْتَ مَعَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: shahidta ma`a alnnabiyyi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: You presented yourself with the Prophet—peace be upon him and his Household—
during all battles and expeditions that he led;
you always carried the pennon with him
and stroke (the enemies) with your sword before him.
Then, due to your prominent determination
and your sagacity in all affairs,
he (i.e. the Prophet) appointed you as the commander on all occasions,
and you were never under the commandment of another.

blocks.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ أَمْرٍ صَدَّكَ عَنْ إِمْضَاءِ عَزْمِكَ فِيهِ ٱلتُّقَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: wa kam min amrin saddaka `an imda'i `azmika fihi alttuqa
blocks.english: On many occasions, your piety prevented you from doing what you had decided about a matter,
while your rival followed his (personal) lust and committed that matter.

blocks.arabic: فَظَنَّ ٱلْجَاهِلُونَ أَنَّكَ عَجَزْتَ عَمَّا إِلَيْهِ ٱنْتَهَىٰ
blocks.english: Thus, the ignorant ones thought that you were incapable of doing that which had been done by your rival!

blocks.arabic: ضَلَّ وَٱللَّهِ الظَّانُّ لِذٰلِكَ وَمَا ٱهْتَدَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: dalla wallahi alzzannu lidhalika wa ma ihtada
blocks.english: I swear by Allah that any one who thought so had missed the right thing and had never found the true guidance.

blocks.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْضَحْتَ مَا أَشْكَلَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ تَوَهَّمَ وَٱمْتَرَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: wa laqad awdahta ma ashkala min dhalika liman tawahhama wamtara
blocks.english: However, you clarified the misunderstanding in which those who fancied and doubted fell
by your saying—may Allah’s peace be upon you:

blocks.transliteration: qad yara alhuwwalu alqullabu wajha alhilati
blocks.english: “One who has been through thick and thin of life finds the excuses

blocks.transliteration: wa dunaha hajizun min taqwa allahi
blocks.english: to be preventing him from orders and prohibitions of Allah,
but he disregards them despite capability (to succumb to them and instead follows the commands of Allah),

blocks.arabic: وَيَنْتَهِزُ فُرْصَتَهَا مَنْ لاَ حَرِيجَةَ لَهُ فِي ٱلدِّينِ.“
blocks.transliteration: wa yantahizu fursataha man la harijata lahu fi alddini
blocks.english: while one who has no restraints of religion seizes the opportunity (and accepts the excuses for not following the commands of Allah).”
You have said the very truth; I swear it by Allah, and the followers of vanity are indeed losers.
And when the two preachers (of their allegiance) tried to deceive you;
and said, “We want to go on `umrah!”

blocks.arabic: فَقُلْتَ لَهُمَا: لَعَمْرُكُمَا مَا تُرِيدَانِ ٱلْعُمْرَةَ
blocks.transliteration: faqulta lahuma la`amrukuma ma turidani al`umrata
blocks.english: You thus answered them, “I swear by your lives; you do not want to go on `umrah;
rather, you want to betray me!”
Hence, you made covenant with them again
and you renewed their allegiance to you;
but they exerted all efforts to act hypocritically.

blocks.arabic: فَلَمَّا نَبَّهْتَهُمَا عَلَىٰ فِعْلِهِمَا أَغْفَلاَ وَعَادَا وَمَا ٱنْتَفَعَا
blocks.transliteration: falamma nabbahtahuma `ala fi`lihima aghfala wa `ada wa ma intafa`a
blocks.english: And when you drew their attentions to this act, they neglected, redid it again, and did not follow your advice.
Thus, their end result was loss.
After them, the people of Syria (mutinied)!
So, you went to fight them after you had provided all excuses,

blocks.transliteration: wa hum la yadinuna dina alhaqqi
blocks.english: while they did not follow the true religion
neither did they understand the Qur'an.
They were rabble, rot, and deviants,

blocks.arabic: وَبِٱلَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ فِيكَ كَافِرُونَ
blocks.transliteration: wa billadhi unzila `ala muhammadin fika kafiruna
blocks.english: and they were unbelievers in what was revealed to Muhammad about your leadership,
and they were supporters of those who antagonized you.

blocks.transliteration: wa qad amara allahu ta`ala bittiba`ika
blocks.english: While, Almighty Allah ordered everyone to follow you
and instructed the believers to support you.
He, the Almighty and All-majestic, has said in this respect:
“O you who believe!

blocks.transliteration: ittaqu allaha wa kunu ma`a alssadiqina
blocks.english: Be careful of your duty to Allah, and be with the truthful.”
O master, through you did the right manifest itself,
but the people discarded it.

blocks.transliteration: wa awdahta alssunana ba`da alddurusi walttamsi
blocks.english: And you made clear the (Prophetic) traditions after they had been eradicated and confused.

blocks.arabic: فَلَكَ سَابِقَةُ ٱلْجِهَادِ عَلَىٰ تَصْدِيقِ ٱلتَّنْزِيلِ
blocks.english: Hence, you enjoy the priority of struggling for the sake of confirming the Divine Revelation,

blocks.arabic: وَلَكَ فَضِيلَةُ ٱلْجِهَادِ عَلَىٰ تَحْقِيقِ ٱلتَّأْوِيلِ
blocks.transliteration: wa laka fadilatu aljihadi `ala tahqiqi altta'wili
blocks.english: and you enjoy the virtue of struggling for the sake of confirming the true interpretation (of the Divine Revelation).

blocks.arabic: وَعَدُوُّكَ عَدُوُّ ٱللَّهِ جَاحِدٌ لِرَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Your enemy is in fact the enemy of Allah and the denier of Allah’s Messenger.
Your enemy thus calls for vanity, judges unfairly,

blocks.arabic: وَيَتَأَمَّرُ غَاصِباً وَيَدْعُو حِزْبَهُ إِلَىٰ ٱلنَّارِ
blocks.transliteration: wa yata'ammaru ghasiban wa yad`u hizbahu ila alnnari
blocks.english: usurps the position of rule, and drives his fans to Hellfire.

blocks.transliteration: wa `ammarun yujahidu wa yunadi bayna alssaffayni
blocks.english: While `Ammar (ibn Yasir) strove and called at the two parties (of the battle):
“How eager I am to join Paradise!”

blocks.arabic: وَلَمَّا ٱسْتَسْقَىٰ فَسُقِيَ ٱللَّبَنَ كَبَّرَ وَقَالَ:
blocks.transliteration: wa lamma istasqa fasuqiya allabana kabbara wa qala
blocks.english: When he then asked for a drink, he was served with a drink of milk; he thus shouted, glorifying Allah, and said:

blocks.arabic: ”قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:
blocks.transliteration: qala li rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: “The Messenger of Allah—peace of Allah be upon him and his Household—did say to me:

blocks.arabic: ’آخِرُ شَرَابِكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ضَيَاحٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ
blocks.transliteration: akhiru sharabika min alddunya dayahun min labanin
blocks.english: ‘The last drink that you will have in this world is a cup of milk,
and the transgressing party will kill you.’”
Thus, Abu’l-`ªdiyah al-Fazari faced and killed him.
The curse of Allah

blocks.transliteration: wa la`natu mala'ikatihi wa rusulihi ajma`ina
blocks.english: and the curse of all His angels and Messengers be upon this Abu’l-`ªdiyah,
upon any one who unsheathed a sword against you,
and upon any one against whom you unsheathed your sword—
O Commander of the Faithful—

blocks.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
blocks.transliteration: min almushrikina walmunafiqina ila yawmi alddini
blocks.english: (Curse be upon) the polytheists and the hypocrites up to the Religion Day.
Curse be also upon any one whom is pleased by whatever upsets you,

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكْرَهْهُ وَأَغْمَضَ عَيْنَهُ وَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam yakrahhu wa aghmada `aynahu wa lam yunkir
blocks.english: and curse be upon any one who is not passive for whatever upsets you and upon any one who bypasses and does not deny,

blocks.arabic: أَوْ أَعَانَ عَلَيْكَ بِيَدٍ أَوْ لِسَانٍ
blocks.english: and upon any one who supports your rivals by deeds or words,
and upon any one who fails to support you,
and upon any one who slackens to fight with you,
and upon any one who despises your merits,
and upon any one who denies your right,

blocks.arabic: أَوْ عَدَلَ بِكَ مَنْ جَعَلَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَوْلَىٰ بِهِ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ
blocks.transliteration: aw `adala bika man ja`alaka allahu awla bihi min nafsihi
blocks.english: and upon any one who leaves you and joins one upon whom Almighty Allah has given you priority.

blocks.arabic: وَصَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa salawatu allahi `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Allah’s peace, mercy, and blessings,
compliments, and greetings
be upon you and upon the Imams from your Immaculate Household.
Verily, Allah is Praised and Glorious.
What is more astounding
and more horrible than usurping your right

blocks.arabic: غَصْبُ ٱلصِّدِّيقَةِ ٱلطَّاهِرَةِ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ سَيِّدَةِ ٱلنِّسَاءِ فَدَكاً
blocks.transliteration: ghasbu alssiddiqati alttahirati alzzahra'i sayyidati alnnisa'i fadakan
blocks.english: is the usurpation of Fadak from the veracious, pure, and luminous Lady, the doyenne of the women of the world!

blocks.transliteration: wa raddu shahadatika wa shahadati alssayyidayni sulalatika
blocks.english: As well as the rejection of your testimony and the testimonies of the two masters—your descendants,
and the Household of the Chosen Prophet, may Allah’s peace be upon you all.

blocks.arabic: وَقَدْ أَعْلَىٰ ٱللَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ عَلَىٰ ٱلأُمَّةِ دَرَجَتَكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa qad a`la allahu ta`ala `ala al-ummati darajatakum
blocks.english: Whereas Almighty Allah has elevated you in rank over the nation,
raised your positions,

blocks.transliteration: wa abana fadlakum wa sharafakum `ala al`alamina
blocks.english: and demonstrated your preference and honorable favorability over all the created beings.
He thus removed away filth from you and purified you with the most thorough purification.
Allah the Almighty and All-majestic says:
“Indeed, man is created of a hasty temperament.
Being greatly grieved when evil afflicts him
and niggardly when good befalls him,
except those who pray.”
Hence, Almighty Allah has excluded His Chosen Prophet

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْتَ يَا سَيِّدَ ٱلأَوْصِيَاءِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ ٱلْخَلْقِ
blocks.transliteration: wa anta ya sayyida al-awsiya'i min jami`i alkhalqi
blocks.english: you, the chief of the Prophets’ successors, from among all His beings.

blocks.arabic: فَمَا أَعْمَهَ مَنْ ظَلَمَكَ عَنِ ٱلْحَقِّ
blocks.english: How deviant from the right he who has wronged you is!

blocks.arabic: ثُمَّ أَفْرَضُوكَ سَهْمَ ذَوِي ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ مَكْراً
blocks.transliteration: thumma afraduka sahma dhawi alqurba makran
blocks.english: They then deceptively decided the share of ‘Near of Kin’ to be for you,
after they wrongly deprived its meritorious people of it.

blocks.arabic: فَلَمَّا آلَ ٱلأَمْرُ إِلَيْكَ أَجْرَيْتَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَجْرَيَا
blocks.transliteration: falamma ala al-amru ilayka ajraytahum `ala ma ajraya
blocks.english: When the matter (of rule) was returned to you, you continued carrying out what they had decided,

blocks.arabic: رَغْبَةً عَنْهُمَا بِمَا عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ لَكَ
blocks.english: because you desired for what is stored by Allah for you.

blocks.arabic: فَأَشْبَهَتْ مِحْنَتُكَ بِهِمَا مِحَنَ ٱلأَنْبِيَاءِ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
blocks.transliteration: fa'ashbahat mihnatuka bihima mihana al-anbiya'i `alayhimu alssalamu
blocks.english: Your ordeals are thus similar to the ordeals encountered by the Prophets, peace be upon them,
who also faced loneliness and absence of supporters.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْبَهْتَ فِي ٱلْبَيَاتِ عَلَىٰ الْفِرَاشِ ٱلذَّبِيحَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashbahta fi albayati `ala alfirashi aldhdhabiha `alayhi alssalamu
blocks.english: As you replaced the Prophet by spending that night on his bed instead of him, this situation was similar to the situation of the self-sacrificing Prophet, peace be upon him.
Because you responded (to the Prophet’s order) in the same way as he (i.e. Prophet Isma`il) responded (to his father’s request),

blocks.arabic: وَأَطَعْتَ كَمَا أَطَاعَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ صَابِراً مُحْتَسِباً
blocks.transliteration: wa ata`ta kama ata`a isma`ilu sabiran muhtasiban
blocks.english: and you obeyed the Prophet in the same way as (Prophet) Isma`il obeyed with steadfastness and reliance upon Allah.

blocks.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ: يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ
blocks.transliteration: idh qala lahu ya bunayya inni ara fi almanami anni adhbahuka
blocks.english: Hence, when his father said to him, ‘O my son! Surely, I have seen in a dream that I should sacrifice you;
consider then what you see.’

blocks.arabic: قَالَ: يَا أَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ
blocks.transliteration: qala ya abati if`al ma tu'maru
blocks.english: He said, ‘O my father! Do what you are commanded;

blocks.arabic: سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّابِرِينَ.
blocks.transliteration: satajiduni in sha'a allahu min alssabirina
blocks.english: if Allah please, you will find me of the patient ones.’

blocks.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَمَّا أَبَاتَكَ ٱلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa kadhalika anta lamma abataka alnnabiyyu salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: The same situation with you, when the Prophet—peace be upon him and his Household—chose you to replace him,

blocks.transliteration: wa amaraka an tadja`a fi marqadihi
blocks.english: and ordered you to sleep in his bed instead of him
so that you should protect him by sacrificing yourself for him,
you quickly responded to his request with obedience,
by exposing yourself to killing fearlessly.
So, Allah the All-exalted appreciated this obedience to him

blocks.arabic: وَأَبَانَ عَنْ جَمِيلِ فِعْلِكَ بِقَوْلِهِ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ:
blocks.transliteration: wa abana `an jamili fi`lika biqawlihi jalla dhikruhu
blocks.english: and He, majestic be His mention, declared your excellent deed by saying:

blocks.arabic: ”وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ ٱبْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاةِ ٱللَّهِ.“
blocks.transliteration: wa min alnnasi man yashri nafsahu ibtigha'a mardati allahi
blocks.english: “And among men is he who sells himself to seek the pleasure of Allah.”
Then, your ordeal on the Battle of Siffin,

blocks.transliteration: wa qad rufi`at almasahifu hilatan wa makran
blocks.english: when books of the Qur'an were raised (on spearheads) out of trickery and deception,
causing doubt to be aroused,
the truth to be neglected,
and conjecture to be followed,

blocks.arabic: أَشْبَهَتْ مِحْنَةَ هَارُونَ إِذْ أَمَّرَهُ مُوسَىٰ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَتَفَرَّقُوٱ عَنْهُ
blocks.transliteration: ashbahat mihnata haruna idh ammarahu musa `ala qawmihi fatafarraqu `anhu
blocks.english: this ordeal was similar to the ordeal of (Prophet) Aaron when (Prophet) Moses appointed him as the leader of his people, but they left him alone,

blocks.transliteration: wa harunu yunadi bihim wa yaqulu
blocks.english: while (Prophet) Aaron was calling at them, saying:

blocks.arabic: يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمٰنُ
blocks.transliteration: ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wa inna rabbakum alrrahmanu
blocks.english: ‘O my people! You are only tried by it, and surely your Lord is the Beneficent Allah.
Therefore, follow me and obey my order.’

blocks.arabic: قَالُوٱْ: لَنْ نَبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ.
blocks.transliteration: qalu lan nabraha `alayhi `akifina hatta yarji`a ilayna musa
blocks.english: They said, ‘We will by no means cease to keep to its worship until Moses returns to us.’

blocks.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْتَ لَمَّا رُفِعَتِ ٱلْمَصَاحِفُ قُلْتَ:
blocks.transliteration: wa kadhalika anta lamma rufi`at almasahifu qulta
blocks.english: Similarly, when the books of the Qur'an were raised (on spearheads), you said:

blocks.arabic: يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهَا وَخُدِعْتُمْ
blocks.transliteration: ya qawmi innama futintum biha wa khudi`tum
blocks.english: ‘O my people, you are only tried by this and you have been surely cheated.’
Nevertheless, they disobeyed you and did the opposite.
And when they demanded with nominating two arbitrators (one from each party),

blocks.arabic: فَأَبَيْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَتَبَرَّأْتَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ وَفَوَّضْتَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: fa'abayta `alayhim wa tabarra'ta ila allahi min fi`lihim wa fawwadtahu ilayhim
blocks.english: you rejected and declared your disavowal of this act before Allah, and then asked them to do whatever they wanted.
Thus, when the truth manifested itself
the wrong was proven as futile,
and they confessed of their flaw and deviation from the right thing,
they also mutinied after that

blocks.arabic: وَأَلْزَمُوكَ عَلَىٰ سَفَهِ ٱلتَّحْكِيمِ ٱلَّذِي أَبَيْتَهُ وَأَحَبُّوهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa alzamuka `ala safahi alttahkimi alladhi abaytahu wa ahabbuhu
blocks.english: and obliged you to commit to the nonsensical result of the arbitration that you had rejected and they had accepted,

blocks.transliteration: wa hazartahu wa abahu dhanbahumu alladhi iqtarafuhu
blocks.english: and you had forbidden it, and they then confessed of the sin that they had committed.

blocks.transliteration: wa anta `ala nahji basiratin wa hudan
blocks.english: While you were following the course of sagacity and true guidance,
they were following the courses of deviation and blindness.
Nonetheless, they insisted on hypocrisy
and involved themselves in seduction
until Allah made them taste the evil result of their conduct.

blocks.arabic: فَأَمَاتَ بِسَيْفِكَ مَنْ عَانَدَكَ فَشَقِيَ وَهَوَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: Fa'amata bisayfika man `anadaka fashaqiya wa hawa
blocks.english: He thus deadened, through your sword, those who mutinied against you, causing them eternal misery and perdition,

blocks.transliteration: wa ahya bihujjatika man sa`ada fahudiya
blocks.english: and He gave life, through your acting as His argument, to those whom He decided as happy; therefore, they were guided (to the true choice).
Allah’s blessings be upon you, coming and going,
and still and moving.
Certainly, no one praising you can ever cover your actual characteristics
and no one criticizing you can ever belittle your merits.
You are verily the best worshipper of all created beings,
the most sincere in asceticism,
and the most enthusiastic defender of the religion.
You executed the laws of Allah with exceptional efforts
and damaged the armies of the apostates with your sword.
You can extinguish the flames of battles with your finger,
tear out the curtains of seditions with your eloquent language,

blocks.arabic: وَتَكْشِفُ لَبْسَ ٱلْبَاطِلِ عَنْ صَرِيحِ ٱلْحَقِّ
blocks.transliteration: wa takshifu labsa albatili `an sarihi alhaqqi
blocks.english: and distinguish the confusing wrong from the plain right.

blocks.arabic: لاَ تَأْخُذُكَ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
blocks.transliteration: la ta'khudhuka fi allahi lawmatu la'imin
blocks.english: You are never influenced by any censure as long as you work for the sake of Allah.

blocks.arabic: وَفِي مَدْحِ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ لَكَ غِنَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: wa fi madhi allahi ta`ala laka ghinan
blocks.english: The praising of Allah the All-exalted to you suffices
from the praising of any other one and from the approval of the depicters.
Almighty Allah says:

blocks.arabic: ”مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوٱ مَا عَاهَدُوٱ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ
blocks.transliteration: min almu'minina rijalun sadaqu ma `ahadu allaha `alayhi
blocks.english: “Of the believers are men who are true to the covenant which they made with Allah.

blocks.arabic: فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوٱ تَبْدِيلاً.“
blocks.transliteration: faminhum man qada nahbahu wa minhum man yantaziru wa ma baddlu tabdilan
blocks.english: So, of them is he who accomplished his vow, of them is he who yet waits, and they have not changed in the least.”

blocks.arabic: وَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ أَنْ قَتَلْتَ ٱلنَّاكِثِينَ وَٱلْقَاسِطِينَ وَٱلْمَارِقِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa lamma ra'ayta an qatalta alnnakithina walqasitina walmariqina
blocks.english: After you felt that you had killed the preachers, the wrongdoers, and the apostates,

blocks.arabic: وَصَدَقَكَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَعْدَهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa sadaqaka rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa`dahu
blocks.english: the predictions of Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household—came true,
and you had fulfilled your promise to him, you then said:

blocks.arabic: أَمَا آنَ أَنْ تُخْضَبَ هٰذِهِ مِنْ هٰذِهِ؟
blocks.transliteration: ama ana an tukhdaba hadhihi min hadhihi
blocks.english: “Has time not come yet so that this (beard) shall be dyed with the blood of this (head)?
When will the most unfortunate of them be sent (to slay me)?”

blocks.arabic: وَاثِقاً بِأَنَّكَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكَ
blocks.english: You were always confident that you were proceeding on clear proof from your Lord,
you were acting with sure knowledge of what you do,
you were on your way to Allah,
and you were rejoicing in the bargain that you had made with Him;
and that is the supreme triumph.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَوْصِيَاءِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma il`an qatalata anbiya'ika wa awsiya'i anbiya'ika
blocks.english: O Allah, curse the murderers of your Prophets and the murderers of Your Prophets’ successors
with the variant curses (that You have prepared for them),
and make those slayers to taste the heat of Your fire.
And also curse those who usurped the right of Your friend,
those who denied their allegiance to him,

blocks.arabic: وَجَحَدَهُ بَعْدَ ٱلْيَقِينِ وَٱلإِقْرَارِ بِٱلْوِلاَيَةِ لَهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa jahadahu ba`da alyaqini wal-iqrari bilwilayati lahu
blocks.english: and those who rejected him after they had witnessed and declared their loyalty to him
on the day when you completed your religion through him.
O Allah, curse those who slew the Commander of the Faithful,

blocks.transliteration: wa man zalamahu wa ashya`ahum wa ansarahum
blocks.english: curse those who wronged him, and curse their adherents and supporters.

blocks.transliteration: allahumma il`an zalimi alhusayni wa qatilihi
blocks.english: O Allah, curse those who wronged and slew al-Husayn,
and curse those who adhered to his enemies and those who supported them,

blocks.transliteration: walrradina biqatlihi wa khadhilihi la`nan wabilan
blocks.english: and curse those who were pleased by the murder of killing al-Husayn and those who disappointed him, with violent cursing.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ ظَلَمَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma il`an awwala zalimin zalama ala muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, curse the first one to invent the wronging against the Household of Muhammad
and curse those who deprived them of their rights.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ خُصَّ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ وَغَاصِبٍ لآِلِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِٱللَّعْنِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma khussa awwala zalimin wa ghasibin li'ali muhammadin billa`ni
blocks.english: O Allah, pour violent curses upon the first one who wronged and usurped the rights of the Household of Muhammad,

blocks.arabic: وَكُلَّ مُسْتَنٍّ بِمَا سَنَّ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa kulla mustannin bima sanna ila yawmi alqiyamati
blocks.english: and curse all those who followed those wrongdoers up to the Resurrection Day.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ عَلِيٍّ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa `ala `aliyyin sayyidi alwasiyyina wa alihi alttahirina
blocks.english: and upon `Ali, the chief of the Prophets’ successors, and upon his immaculate Household,
(please do) make us adhere to them firmly,
and include us with those who shall be winners and secured because they abode by their leadership;

blocks.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
blocks.transliteration: alladhina la khawfun `alayhim wa la hum yahzanuna
blocks.english: those upon whom there shall come no fear, nor shall they grieve.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام علی روز غدیر کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
